newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: U.S. rice major sales activity in the week ended Sept 19 reported by exporters for the following purchasing countries, in tonnes:
A- includes 9,500 tonnes of rough rice.
Net sales of 62,400 tonnes were 25 percent below the previous week and 25 percent above the four-week average.
Exports of 30,000 were 40 percent below the previous week and 37 percent below the four-week average.
Primary Export Destinations: Mexico, Netherlands Antilles and the Leeward and Windward Islands.
